استئموا (form X)
# اُسْتُئِمُّوا (ustuʔimmū) /us.tu.ʔim.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَئِمُّوا (istaʔimmū) /is.ta.ʔim.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
